jobs.title: Director, Financial Crimes Risk Assessment
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

As Director, Financial Crimes Risk Assessment you are responsible for the design and execution of the enterprise risk assessment. In this role, you will identify and assess inherent risks and control effectiveness, demonstrate compliance, and identify opportunities to optimize the financial crimes program, by:

Leading the enterprise-wide assessment of financial crimes risks and controls globally and across RBC Platforms, businesses units, and jurisdictions.
Leading the development of capabilities to enable the quantitative and qualitative assessment of inherent risks, control effectiveness, and residual risk.
Performing expert analysis to identify concentrations of risk and adequacy of controls to ultimately inform and recommend risk mitigation strategies.
Delivering high-quality risk assessment products to support regulatory compliance and inform business decisions.
Remaining abreast of emerging risks and evolving regulatory environment to continuously refine RBC’s risk assessment approach.

What will you do?

Lead the efficient and effective execution of enterprise-wide risk assessment activities, in line with regulatory and business expectations.
Lead the development and continuous improvement of the Enterprise Risk Assessment Methodology and operating procedures.
Identify gaps and opportunities to enhance risk assessment data integration, tools, and processes to drive efficiency and consistency across assessments.
Identify requirements for analytic tools and capabilities to perform quantitative and qualitative assessments of inherent risks, controls and residual risk
Collaborate across financial crimes program to establish risk rating frameworks, validate results, align on mitigation strategies and produce reports.
Establish roadmaps and provide regular reporting on risk assessment activities including data collection and integration, analysis and report generation.
Identify and escalate material risk exposures and control gaps
Support regulatory exams, audits and internal reviews related to risk assessment activities
Monitor changes in AML/ATF regulations and participate in industry related initiatives to remain abreast of existing and new laws and regulatory expectations

What do you need to succeed?

Must have

Post-secondary education or equivalent
Proven experience with executing financial crime risk assessments
Strong ability to evaluate and design risk assessment capabilities and tools
Deep understanding of global financial crime regulatory environment
Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, actionable insights
Experience working with cross-functional teams
Project management

Nice to have

Graduate degree (MBA or relevant subject matter area)
Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) designation or other related certifications

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
To be part of a large and growing global organization which puts client interests first and has a culture of fairness and accountability

Job Skills

Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Control Analysis, Cross-Functional Leadership, Data Analysis, Data Literacy, Executive Reports, Financial Crimes Compliance, People Management, Professional Writing, Project Management, Regulatory Risk, Risk Assessments, Risk Mitigation Strategies

jobs.description:
Associate Director, Strategy (Ecommerce)

Job Details

Role:
Associate Director, Strategy (Ecommerce)

Department
: Performance

Job Location:
Remote (Canada)

Role Type:
Full-Time, Permanent

Hours:
Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Starting New Hire Pay:
$112,000 - $130,000 CAD + Benefits

Full Pay Band:
$112,000 - $151,000 CAD + Profit Sharing (after 1 year of employment) + Benefits

Role Availability:
This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around ecommerce, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside. Think breakout DTC and omnichannel consumer brands, the ones already in your cart, your closet and your feed, whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them. You'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how paid media compounds into revenue, customer lifetime value and durable, profitable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we acquire new customers profitably, know which spend is truly incremental, and scale without giving up margin? The tactical craft matters (shopping feeds, creative testing, ROAS, CAC and MER performance), but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most exciting consumer brands out there grow. If your idea of success starts and ends with in-platform ROAS, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about ecommerce as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department as Associate Director, Strategy, you’ll deliver strategic leadership to performance teams, leveraging industry trends to evolve Thrive’s services and client marketing strategies. You’ll partner closely with leadership to align team goals with company growth, while managing key relationships and ensuring the long-term success of high-complexity, projects and prospects.

Your focus of responsibilities will be:

Domain:
Recognized as a leader in performance marketing both within Thrive and in the industry, you make expert contributions to the Performance department, ensuring long-term project success and enhancing the skills of those involved.
Client:
Championing client success as the hands-on strategic lead across large, multi-faceted accounts, digging into performance, solving problems directly, and refining processes across projects and teams to strengthen client partnerships and retention.
People:
Manage a team of senior performance marketers and act as an advocate at scale. Helping others elevate their performance marketing skills or add new skills to their toolkit for project growth and performance. You lead a results-driven culture that in turn leads to consistent and measurable growth.
Company:
Support senior leadership in the Performance department and collaborate with other supporting function leaders to develop, set and execute the roadmap for Thrive's short to long-term performance marketing product and services plans.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

In your first 30 days you’ll
become familiar with Thrive’s tools, processes, and expectations for high-complexity accounts, while building relationships across Performance leadership, strategists, and key cross-functional partners.
In your first 60 days you’ll
begin actively contributing strategic input across high-complexity accounts, supporting key client moments alongside account leaders, and identifying early opportunities to strengthen delivery consistency, team workflow, or performance standards.
In your first 90 days you’ll
step into leading high-impact client moments for high-complexity accounts, demonstrate measurable impact through improved team execution and client outcomes.

Qualifications

You’ve led and owned large-scale, multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing programs with monthly media spend exceeding $1M USD, driving sustained performance across platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).
You’ve led and developed multi-level teams of 15+, including managing managers, setting performance standards, and scaling team impact through others.
You’ve designed and evolved performance reporting and dashboards (using tools like Looker, Google Sheets, Excel, Tableau…) that enable clear decision-making, executive communication, and accountability against business KPIs.
You’ve led initiatives and process improvements adopted at the department or company level, raising performance standards and operational consistency.
You’ve owned performance strategy across diverse business models, leading forecasting, pacing, and measurement while confidently advising senior and C-suite executive stakeholders.
You’ve led complex client relationships with multiple senior executive stakeholders, navigating high-stakes situations and driving buy-in through clear, confident communication and strategic recommendations.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

jobs.title: Senior Director - Customer Analytics, Data & AI
jobs.description:
Location: Markham, Ontario

Job Description:

Position:
Senior Director, Customer Analytics, Data & AI

Type:
Full-Time | Hybrid

Location:
Markham, ON

Reports to
: VP, Loyalty & Customer Analytics

About Us

Pet Valu is Canada’s leading pet specialty retailer, dedicated to strengthening the bond between dedicated pet lovers and their pets. With 50 years of animal care expertise, we operate over 800 stores across Canada under several banners, including Pet Valu, Bosley’s, Total Pet, Paulmac's Pet, Tisol & Chico. Guided by our mission to deliver products, care, expertise, and memorable moments, Pet Valu is a place where people build meaningful careers while making a positive impact on pets and communities.

What will you do?

The Senior Director, Customer Intelligence, Data & AI
is responsible for defining and executing Pet Valu's enterprise Customer Intelligence strategy, enabling the organization to maximize customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifetime value through data-driven decision making.

This role provides strategic leadership across Customer Analytics, Business Intelligence, Customer Data Strategy, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Customer Measurement. The Senior Director serves as the organization's authority on customer behavior, customer value, and customer growth opportunities, translating complex data into actionable business strategies that support enterprise objectives.

Working closely with Marketing, Digital, Merchandising, Operations, Finance, Technology, and Executive Leadership, this role develops the analytical frameworks, predictive capabilities, AI roadmap, and customer intelligence infrastructure necessary to drive long-term growth and competitive differentiation.

The Senior Director also leads the development of an enterprise Customer Intelligence Centre of Excellence, ensuring insights, measurement, experimentation, and advanced analytics capabilities are embedded throughout the organization and consistently influence strategic and investment decisions.

This position manages a portfolio of customer data, analytics, AI, and technology investments intended to improve customer experience, strengthen loyalty, and generate measurable commercial value.

Responsibilities:

Enterprise Customer Intelligence Strategy

Owns:

Enterprise Customer Intelligence Strategy
Customer Growth Insights Strategy
Customer Value Management Framework
Customer KPI Governance
Executive Customer Performance Reporting
Loyalty Analytics Centre of Excellence

Responsibilities:

Define and execute a multi-year Customer Intelligence strategy aligned to corporate growth objectives.
Act as the leader responsible for developing the organization's understanding of customer behavior, value, retention, and growth opportunities.
Establish enterprise customer measurement frameworks and key performance indicators used across business units.
Identify strategic opportunities to improve customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, retention, and profitability.
Partner with executive stakeholders to embed customer intelligence into strategic planning, resource allocation, and business decision-making processes.
Lead the development of an enterprise Customer Intelligence Centre of Excellence, driving best practices across analytics, measurement, experimentation, and insight generation.
Provide strategic recommendations and executive-level guidance regarding customer investment priorities and growth opportunities.

Customer Analytics & Advanced Insights

Owns:

Customer Analytics Strategy
Customer Segmentation Framework
Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) Methodology
Retention & Churn Analytics
Customer Health Measurement

Responsibilities:

Lead the development of advanced customer analytics capabilities that identify opportunities to improve customer value and business performance.
Oversee customer segmentation, lifetime value modeling, retention analysis, cohort analysis, and behavioral analytics.
Establish customer health and retention frameworks that proactively identify risks and opportunities across customer segments.
Partner with Loyalty, CRM, Digital, and Merchandising teams to improve customer engagement through actionable analytics and insight generation.
Translate customer data into executive recommendations that influence merchandising, promotional, loyalty, and customer experience strategies.

Data Science, AI & Predictive Intelligence

Owns:

Enterprise Loyalty AI Roadmap
Predictive Analytics Strategy
Advanced Personalization Analytics
Next-Generation Customer Intelligence Capabilities

Responsibilities:

Define and lead the organization's customer-focused AI and advanced analytics strategy.
Establish predictive modeling capabilities including churn prediction, customer lifetime value forecasting, propensity scoring, next-best-offer models, recommendation engines, and customer growth forecasting.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify practical applications that deliver measurable business value.
Partner with CRM, Loyalty, and Digital teams to operationalize predictive intelligence and support increasingly personalized customer experiences.
Develop governance frameworks that ensure AI initiatives are aligned with business objectives and executed responsibly.
Foster innovation through experimentation with emerging analytical techniques, machine learning solutions, and decision intelligence capabilities.

Customer Data Strategy & Governance

Owns:

Customer Data Strategy
Customer 360 Roadmap
Customer Data Governance
Identity Resolution Strategy
Customer Information Architecture

Responsibilities:

Define and oversee the customer data ecosystem required to support enterprise customer intelligence objectives.
Ensure customer data assets are accurate, accessible, scalable, secure, and actionable.
Oversee integration of customer, loyalty, retail, digital, eCommerce, app, and marketing datasets into a unified customer intelligence environment.
Partner with Technology, Digital, and external vendors to establish scalable customer data foundations and future-state capabilities.
Lead governance frameworks that support data quality, compliance, consistency, and effective enterprise data utilization.

Enterprise Measurement & Experimentation

Owns:

Measurement Strategy
Attribution Framework
Incrementality Measurement
Test-and-Learn Program
Customer Investment Evaluation Framework

Responsibilities:

Develop enterprise measurement frameworks that assess the commercial effectiveness of customer, marketing, loyalty, CRM, personalization, and digital initiatives.
Establish rigorous test-and-learn methodologies and experimentation standards.
Quantify the incremental impact of major customer investments, including loyalty programs, customer apps, personalization initiatives, and customer engagement platforms.
Lead the development of ROI frameworks used to assess customer and technology investments.
Ensure business decisions are supported by credible, transparent, and actionable evidence.

Strategic Investment & Business Performance Leadership

Owns:

Analytics Portfolio Management
Customer Growth Recommendations
Executive Decision Support

Responsibilities:

Develop business cases supporting customer, loyalty, digital, AI, and technology investments.
Provide executive leadership with actionable recommendations regarding customer growth opportunities, investment prioritization, and strategic trade-offs.
Influence enterprise planning through data-driven insights and predictive forecasts.
Partner with Finance and business leaders to ensure customer investments deliver measurable commercial outcomes.
Manage a portfolio of customer intelligence, analytics, and technology investments intended to drive long-term value creation.

Leadership & Organizational Capability Development

Owns:

Customer Intelligence Organization
Talent Strategy
Analytics Centre of Excellence
Capability Development Roadmap

Responsibilities:

Build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary team spanning customer analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, data science, and artificial intelligence.
Develop future capability plans supporting organizational growth and evolving customer intelligence requirements.
Coach, mentor, and develop analytical and technical talent.
Foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Build strong partnerships across Marketing, Finance, Merchandising, Technology, Operations, and Digital teams.
Serve as a visible thought leader and advocate for customer-centric decision-making throughout the organization.

Loyalty & MarTech Platform Strategy

Own the vision, roadmap, and governance of the loyalty and MarTech ecosystem, including CRM, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), loyalty platforms, marketing automation, and customer engagement technologies.
Align platform capabilities with customer, loyalty, and business objectives.
Develop and execute the long-term Loyalty and MarTech strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise customer, digital, and marketing objectives.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend platform enhancements to improve customer engagement and marketing effectiveness.

Product Ownership & Delivery

Serve as Business Product Owner for key loyalty and MarTech platforms.
Define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, and manage platform roadmaps.
Collaborate with IT, Product, and external vendors to ensure successful implementation and ongoing optimization of capabilities.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

Manage strategic relationships with MarTech vendors and service partners.
Negotiate contracts, oversee platform performance, and ensure service level expectations are met.
Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Lead strategic partnerships with key vendors and external partners to ensure technology investments deliver expected business outcomes and return on investment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
Master's degree or MBA is considered an asset.
10+ years in Data Science, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, CRM Analytics, Loyalty Analytics, or Customer Insights.
7+ years leading analytics, BI, data science, or customer intelligence teams.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing enterprise customer intelligence, analytics, or data strategies that influence corporate growth objectives.
Proven success leading large-scale business transformation initiatives involving data platforms, cloud migrations, CDP, digital engagement, CRM, personalization, loyalty, or AI capabilities.
Experience serving as a strategic advisor to executive leadership teams, translating customer insights into business, marketing, digital, and commercial strategies.
Experience establishing and scaling customer analytics, data science, or AI capabilities within a complex retail, eCommerce, loyalty, or consumer-focused environment.
Extensive experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives across Marketing operations, Digital, Merchandising, Finance, IT, Operations, and Executive Leadership teams.
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive organizational alignment without direct authority.
Experience managing competing priorities across multiple business units while balancing commercial, customer, operational, and technical requirements.
Track record of influencing enterprise investment decisions through analytics, business cases, and ROI measurement frameworks.
Demonstrated accountability for delivering measurable commercial outcomes, including customer retention, customer lifetime value growth, revenue growth, and return on investment.
Expert level knowledge of data integrations, data engineering, governance, API ecosystems, and data architecture.

Preferred:

Experience in retail, eCommerce, loyalty, or customer-centric industries

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).
